Message.En:
[Mortality Check Quest] Listen to the
requester's wish.
Defeat the ferocious enemy without
reviving even once.
Message.Jp:
【死亡チェッククエスト】
依頼者の願いを聞き入れ
一度も復活することなく狂暴な敵を討伐する

Message.En:
Someone in the
<NAME AREA>
appears to be testing their skills in a
battle against an enemy.
Message.Jp:
<NAME AREA>にいる何者かが、魔物との勝負で
腕試しをしているようだ

Message.En:
Recently, the vice captain has 
been looking quite troubled. They 
always seem to have their head 
down. Apparently, they're dealing 
with a lot of paperwork outside 
the battlefield and are getting 
really frustrated. Plus, they 
have many useless subordinates 
making things even tougher. Me? 
Oh no, I'm different—hahaha!
Message.Jp:
最近――副隊長の顔が浮かないんです
いつもうつむいているというか――
なんでも戦場以外の事務仕事が多くて
嫌になってるらしいんです
加えて、使えない部下が多くて大変だとか
え、僕？　僕は違いますよ――アハハ
